sn40.6:1.4: Idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Anattaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati ||
sn40.6:1.6: So khvāham āvuso sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanam samatikkamma Anattaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn40.6:1.7: tassa mayham āvuso iminā vihārena viharato ākāsānañcāyatanasahāgatā saññā manasikārā samudācaranti || || 6
sn40.6:2.1: Atha kho mam āvuso Bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca ||
sn40.6:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa viññāṇañcāyatanam pamādo viññāṇañcāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi viññāṇañcāyatane cittam ekodikarohi viññāṇañcāyatane cittaṃ samādahāti || || 7
sn40.6:2.4: So khvāham āvuso aparena samayena sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Anattaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanam upasampajja vihāsiṃ || || 8
sn40.6:2.5: Yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya || pe || mahabhiññatam patto
